label: Rawls contrasted his 'original position' with Smith's 'impartial spectator', arguing the spectator conflates separate persons into one generalized observer
description: John Rawls formulated a fundamental critique of "The Impartial Spectator", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "The Impartial Spectator".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
